description: Class representing an entry of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

Delete.description: Deletes the specified item in the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiContentControlListEntry class.

GetIndex.description: Returns an index of the content control list item in the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetParent.description: Returns a parent of the content control list item in the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetText.description: Returns a String that represents the display text of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetValue.description: Returns a String that represents the value of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.

MoveDown.description: Moves the current item in the parent combo box / drop-down list content control down one element, so that it is after the item that originally followed it.

MoveUp.description: Moves the current item in the parent combo box / drop-down list content control up one element.

Select.description: Selects the list entry in the combo box / drop-down list content control and sets the text of the content control to the selected item value.

SetIndex.description: Sets an index to the content control list item in the combo box / drop-down list content control.

params.description: An index of the content control list item.
params.name: nIndex

SetText.description: Sets a String that represents the display text of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.

params.description: The display text of a list item.
params.name: sText

SetValue.description: Sets a String that represents the value of a list item for the combo box / drop-down list content control.

params.description: The value of a list item.
params.name: sValue
